Fort Lp who had been investing in Dun & Bradstreet Corp Del Ne for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.34 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.22% or $0.26 during the last trading session, reaching $116.92. About 17,949 shares traded. The Dun & Bradstreet Corporation (NYSE:DNB) has risen 14.93% since April 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.38% the S&P500.
